description: This file defines a Worker_MultiAgents class implementing INode, responsible for initializing and creating agent nodes for multi-agent workflows, including functions to create agents and handle agent invocation logic.

classes.name: Worker_MultiAgents
classes.description: A class implementing INode to manage multi-agent worker nodes, including initialization and node creation logic.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes a multi-agent worker node with provided node data, input, and options, creating an agent and returning a configured node object.

methods.name: createAgent
methods.description: Creates an agent executor or runnable sequence based on provided tools, prompts, and configurations, supporting function calling models.

methods.name: agentNode
methods.description: Invokes an agent with the current state and configuration, returning the message output or throwing an error if aborted.

methods.name: transformObjectPropertyToFunction
methods.description: Transforms an object’s properties into functions returning their values, used for dynamic variable handling.
